nodes.title: Lookup tables
nodes.summary: Fixed generator and range-check tables loaded before circuit synthesis.

nodes.title: Private Action witnesses
nodes.summary: Old-note data, keys, values, and newly witnessed output-note fields.

nodes.title: Merkle path
nodes.summary: Reconstructs the note-commitment root through 32 Sinsemilla Merkle layers.

nodes.title: Net value commitment
nodes.summary: Range-checks the signed net value and computes ValueCommit(v_net, rcv).

nodes.title: Nullifier derivation
nodes.summary: Combines Poseidon, scalar addition, fixed-base multiplication, and the old commitment.

nodes.title: Spend authority randomization
nodes.summary: Computes rk = ak + [alpha] SpendAuthG and exposes its coordinates.

nodes.title: Incoming-viewing-key commitment
nodes.summary: Hashes and commits ak and nk, with canonicity checks for ivk.

nodes.title: Diversified-address integrity
nodes.summary: Checks pk_d_old = [ivk] g_d_old using variable-base multiplication.

nodes.title: Old note commitment
nodes.summary: Recomputes the spent note commitment and constrains it equal to cm_old.

nodes.title: New note commitment
nodes.summary: Constructs the output note commitment and exposes its x-coordinate.

nodes.title: Orchard Action checks
nodes.summary: Connects value balance, anchor equality, spend/output enable flags, and the post-NU6.3 conditional cross-address restriction.

nodes.title: Anchor instance
nodes.summary: Public anchor against which the reconstructed Merkle root is checked.

nodes.title: Net value commitment x
nodes.summary: Public x-coordinate of cv_net.

nodes.title: Net value commitment y
nodes.summary: Public y-coordinate of cv_net.

nodes.title: Old nullifier
nodes.summary: Public nullifier derived from the old note and incoming viewing key.

nodes.title: Randomized verification key x
nodes.summary: Public x-coordinate of the randomized spend-authority key.

nodes.title: Randomized verification key y
nodes.summary: Public y-coordinate of the randomized spend-authority key.

nodes.title: New note commitment x
nodes.summary: Public x-coordinate of the new note commitment.

nodes.title: Spend-enable flag
nodes.summary: Public control flag used by the Action gate; it is a statement input, not a circuit-derived output.

nodes.title: Output-enable flag
nodes.summary: Public control flag used by the Action gate; it is a statement input, not a circuit-derived output.

nodes.title: Cross-address control
nodes.summary: Public post-NU6.3 control: zero permits distinct receivers; a nonzero value requires the old and new expanded receivers to agree.

edges.label: cm_old + path
edges.summary: Supplies the spent note commitment and its authentication path for reconstruction of the note-commitment tree root.

edges.label: v_old, v_new
edges.summary: Carries the old and new note values into the signed net-value calculation.

edges.label: nk, rho_old, psi_old, cm_old
edges.summary: Provides the nullifier key and old-note material used by Poseidon and the nullifier derivation.

edges.label: ak + alpha
edges.summary: Provides the authorization key and randomizer used to derive the randomized verification key.

edges.label: ak, nk
edges.summary: Carries the authorization and nullifier keys into the incoming-viewing-key commitment.

edges.label: ivk
edges.summary: Uses the committed incoming viewing key to check ownership of the diversified address.

edges.label: g_d_old, pk_d_old
edges.summary: Supplies the old diversified base and transmission key for the address-integrity check.

edges.label: validated pk_d_old
edges.summary: Passes the ownership-checked transmission key into reconstruction of the spent note commitment.

edges.label: old note fields
edges.summary: Carries the old note fields into the Sinsemilla note-commitment computation.

edges.label: rho_new
edges.summary: Reuses the derived nullifier as the rho input of the new note commitment.

edges.label: new note fields
edges.summary: Carries the newly witnessed note fields into the output note-commitment computation.

edges.label: root
edges.summary: Feeds the reconstructed Merkle root to the Action gate for comparison with the public anchor.

edges.label: magnitude + sign
edges.summary: Feeds the signed net-value decomposition to the Action gate's balance constraint.

edges.label: v_old, v_new
edges.summary: Lets the Action gate relate old and new values to the net-value magnitude and sign.

edges.label: anchor
edges.summary: Supplies the public ANCHOR statement input against which the reconstructed root is checked when a spend is enabled.

edges.label: cv_net.x
edges.summary: Exposes the x-coordinate of the computed net value commitment as a public instance.

edges.label: cv_net.y
edges.summary: Exposes the y-coordinate of the computed net value commitment as a public instance.

edges.label: nf_old
edges.summary: Exposes the derived old-note nullifier as the NF_OLD public instance.

edges.label: rk.x
edges.summary: Exposes the x-coordinate of the randomized spend-authority key.

edges.label: rk.y
edges.summary: Exposes the y-coordinate of the randomized spend-authority key.

edges.label: cm_new.x
edges.summary: Exposes the x-coordinate of the newly constructed note commitment.

edges.label: enable_spends
edges.summary: Supplies the public spend-enable flag that activates the spend-side Action requirements.

edges.label: enable_outputs
edges.summary: Supplies the public output-enable flag that activates the output-side Action requirements.

edges.label: disableCrossAddress
edges.summary: Supplies the post-NU6.3 public control whose nonzero branch requires equality of both expanded receivers.
